product.name: Clover Chemicals STC Toilet Cleaner Descaler 1l
product.description:
Toilet and washroom cleaner. STC is used neat for descaling toilets and urinals or as a diluted solution for general washroom cleaning.
The thick blue liquid contains safe sulphamic and citric acids to dissolve limescale and organics and remove grease, body oils and scum from surfaces.

Ideal for cleaning toilets, urinals, showers and sinks, STC is safe for use on stainless steel.

Safe on porcelain, stainless steel, chrome, ceramic and tiled surfaces when used as directed

Spray or pour on to soiled surface, leave for a few minutes contact time. Then flush away thoroughly with water. Agitation with a brush will help remove stubborn stains.

To clean ceramic W.C. bowls and urinals: Apply ZAKOL undiluted to the surface and allow 5 minutes contact time. Agitate heavily stained areas with a toilet brush and then flush the toilet or urinal.

Use biocides safely. Always read the label and product information before use

product.name: Decoupling Membrane 3mm 15m Anti Crack Waterproof Tile Mat Underfloor Heating Vapour Barrier Sound Proof Wet Room Bathroom Kitchen
product.description:
Protect your tiled floors from cracking, movement and moisture damage with this professional-grade 3mm Decoupling Membrane — the essential undertile installation layer trusted by professional tilers and DIY enthusiasts across the UK for ceramic, stone and all standard floor tile installations.
This 3 layer polyethylene composite decoupling membrane is specifically engineered to prevent the transmission of lateral stresses and substrate movement to the finished tiled surface — eliminating the cracking, grouting failure and tile debonding commonly seen when tiling over problematic substrates such as heated screeds, timber floors, OSB, plywood and tongue and groove floorboards that are subject to natural movement.
The membrane channels provide even heat distribution throughout the floor when used in combination with wet or electric underfloor heating systems — eliminating hot and cold spots and ensuring your underfloor heating performs at maximum efficiency without raising the sub-floor level significantly.
Fully waterproof and ideal for wet rooms, bathrooms and kitchens — the polyethylene composite construction protects the substrate from water infiltration preventing damp damage to timber floors and structural substrates below the tile. The integrated vapour barrier provides additional moisture protection whilst the acoustic properties reduce impact sound transmission through the tiled floor.
Simply roll out the membrane, secure it to the substrate and apply your tile adhesive directly to the membrane surface. Compatible with all standard tile adhesives and suitable for use under ceramic, porcelain, stone and all standard floor tiles on concrete, timber, OSB and heated screed substrates.
Supplied as a 15 metre roll at 1 metre width — covering 15 square meters per roll.

product.name: Shower Seal for Screens Doors or Panels, Fits 4, 5 or 6mm Glass, Seals Gaps Up to 16mm, 800mm Length, SEAL005
product.description:
This shower seal is comprised of a high quality rigid PVC U section designed to comfortably grip any glass ranging from 4mm to 6mm thick with no need for any additional adhesive. The bottom of the seal has a soft flexible fin which will seal any gap from 11mm to 16mm.

These seals are commonly found on either the bottom horizontal section of a bath screen or shower door, and can also be used vertically on the upright of the glass to create a seal between the glass and the tiles or wall. Please note that this is a straight shower seal designed only for use on straight glass.

This product comes in 800mm, 900mm, 1400mm or 2000mm lengths and can be cut down to size once you’ve received it.

Installation of our seals is nice and easy. Simply push the seal onto the glass from below on one end and work your way along, pushing the seal up onto the glass as you go. Do not try to slide the seals along the glass as this can damage it.

If you're struggling to find the correct seal for your shower/bath screen then please don't hesitate to get in contact with us. We would be more than happy to help.

product.description:
This shower seal is comprised of a high quality rigid PVC U section designed to comfortably grip any glass ranging from 4mm to 6mm thick with no need for any additional adhesive. The bottom of the seal has a soft flexible bubble which will seal any gap from 10mm to 15mm.

These seals are commonly found on either the bottom horizontal section of a bath screen or shower door, and can also be used vertically on the upright of the glass to create a seal between the glass and the tiles or wall. Please note that this is a straight shower seal designed only for use on straight glass.

This product comes in 800mm, 900mm, 1400mm or 2000mm lengths and can be cut down to size once you’ve received it.

Installation of our seals is nice and easy. Simply push the seal onto the glass from below on one end and work your way along, pushing the seal up onto the glass as you go. Do not try to slide the seals along the glass as this can damage it.

If you're struggling to find the correct seal for your shower/bath screen then please don't hesitate to get in contact with us. We would be more than happy to help.

product.name: Swell Nano Aquarium Sponge Filter with Pump - For Fish Tank Filtration
product.description:
This Swell Nano Sponge Filter is our smallest filter, with a miniature sponge that provides just enough mechanical and biological filtration for a temporary hospital tank, or a small tank with a very low bio load. It also comes with a built-in air stone that'll keep your aquarium aerated with a fine stream of bubbles.
This Swell Nano Sponge Filter is quick and easy to install. Before you place it inside your aquarium, attach the airline provided to the narrow spout in the middle of the filter. Then, use the suction cup provided to attach the filter to an inside surface. After that, attach the other ends of the airline to an air pump. If you've done all that correctly, you should start to see a fine stream of bubbles rising out of the top of the filter. Now all that's left to worry about is keeping it clean. To do that, remove it from your aquarium and give the tiny sponge a little squeeze in a bucket of tank water (or dechlorinated water). This will remove a lot of the trapped debris that may have built up in the sponge. Be careful not to clean your filter in regular tap water, the chlorine, chloramines and trace heavy metals may kill your colony of beneficial bacteria.
A filter is an essential piece of equipment for all aquariums. They do a lot of the heavy lifting in your underwater ecosystem, removing waste from your water column while also providing a home for a large colony of beneficial bacteria. This bacteria breaks down the waste picked up by the filter and, in doing so, keeps your water clean.
There are many different types of filter. Some, like this Swell Nano Sponge Filter, are only suitable for tiny aquariums and temporary hospital tanks. Other filters, like external canister filters, are specially designed for large aquariums with a high water volume. If you have a tiny tank, then this Swell Mini Aquarium Filter is ideal. If you have a large or medium-sized tank, then check out our range of internal filters and external filters.

The All Pond Solutions BF-6000+ small pond filter box complete system is an outstanding biological filter, UV clarifier and pond pump combination that produces clean and clear water for healthy fish and plants to survive.

The built-in UV steriliser will destroy green water algae for a cleaner healthier pond. Water passes through the highly effective UV clarifier and exposes the impurities in the water to UV light. A viewing window is present to safely check the correct functioning of the UVC.

The aerated water passes through Japanese matting and coarse / fine filter foam which extract larger pieces of debris. Also included are bio balls which provide a large surface area for nitro-bacteria development, and will help produce and maintain a high water-oxygen level.

Filtration
Water passes through the BF-6000+ in the following order
1) Pond water flows into the BF-6000+ via your pond pump
2) The pond water is exposed to the 9w UV steriliser which clumps together your algae for filtration
3) After being sterilised the water firstly passes through Japanese matting before going through fine and coarse filter foam
4) Lastly, the water passes across bio balls that harbour good bacteria across large surface area (biological filtration)
5) Clean, clear and healthy water exits your BF-6000+ and returns to your pond.

product.name: Vortex Flush Toilet Water Saving Rimless Inc Soft Close Seat Closed Back Tamara
product.description:
Vortex Flush Toilet Water Saving Rimless Inc Soft Close Seat Closed Back Tamara

	Tamara Vortex flush toilet
	Back to wall style toilet (closed back, hides soil pipe from view)
	High quality sanitaryware
	Close coupled toilet
	Modern styling
	Including high quality soft close seat
	With ‘new Vortex flush technology’, providing an impressive flushing ability
	Rimless design - more hygienic
	With minimal splash back
	Requires less water for flushing
	Less water for flushing 4.2L &amp; 2.2L
	Easy clean
	Quieter flush
	Saves up to 19,700 litres of water a year on average
	Powerful and controlled flush
	WRAS approved

Toilet Sizes approx:

	Width: 360mm
	Depth: 630mm
	Height: 810mm

Cyclone Flush Technology

This Toilet delivers both efficiency and hygiene, with TwistFlush technology using the physical force of a controlled water vortex to flush away almost everything inside the toilet bowl in a sustainable manner, saving precious water every time the flush is activated.
These toilets only need 4.5 litres for a large flush, and only 3 litres for a small one, with a single flush being more than sufficient. In turn, this saves a four-person family up to 19,700 litres of water each year.
Using the special technology, the entire inner pan is flushed and the smartly designed bowl makes it difficult for dirt to stick, thanks to its steep and super smooth walls.
As well as that, the controlled vortex power deploys the flushing water exactly where it is needed, preventing spray and making it significantly quieter than a standard flush.

product.name: SHPELEC 6mm Twin and Earth Cable 6242Y Grey, 2m - Cooker & Shower Circuit Wire, BASEC Approved
product.description:
SHPELEC 6242Y twin and earth cable, 6mm², supplied as one continuous 2m coil. Grey flat T&E for the fixed wiring of dedicated high-current circuits in the home, such as electric cookers, hobs and smaller electric showers.

Which size do you need? 6mm² is commonly used for cooker circuits and smaller electric showers. Larger showers, long cable runs or cable buried in insulation often need 10mm². Socket circuits normally use 2.5mm². Always size the cable from the circuit design or the appliance's installation instructions - never use a smaller size.

Construction: two 6mm² stranded copper conductors (brown and blue) and a 2.5mm² bare copper earth (CPC), PVC insulated with a grey PVC sheath. Max. overall size 7.8 x 15.0mm. Rated 300/500V; minimum operating temperature -15°C, maximum conductor temperature 70°C. Max. conductor resistance at 20°C: 3.08 ohm/km (brown and blue), 7.41 ohm/km (earth). BASEC approved and made to BS 6004.

Current rating: up to 47A clipped direct (BS 7671 reference method C). De-rate for other installation methods, grouping, thermal insulation and long runs.

Installation: fixed wiring in dry or damp locations - clip it to walls or joists, lay it on cable tray or run it in free air where it won't be damaged, and use conduit or trunking where it needs protecting. This is stiff fixed-wiring cable, not a flexible lead. Install only when the cable and the air are above 0°C. Sleeve the bare earth green/yellow at every termination.

In the box: 1 x 2m coil of 6mm² 6242Y twin and earth cable. It is one continuous length, so measure your cable run, allowing extra for terminations, before ordering. Other lengths are available in the length selector. Electrical installation must comply with BS 7671 and the building regulations where you live (e.g. Part P in England and Wales); if in doubt, use a qualified electrician.

product.name: ProWarm 100W Premium Electric Underfloor Heating Mat (for Tile/Stone/Laminate/Wood) - 12m²
product.description:
Take the chill off tile, stone, laminate and engineered wood floors with ProWarm electrical underfloor heating. Designed for bathrooms, kitchens and living spaces, the pre-spaced mesh mat provides discreet, even warmth and can supplement or replace radiators when sized for room heat loss. Insulation and thermostat control help direct heat upwards and limit wasted energy. Roll out the mat, cut the mesh only to turn it, then spread flexible tile adhesive or pour self-levelling compound over the cable. Never cut the heating cable or fit it beneath fixed furniture. A 4 metre cold tail aids routing. A qualified electrician must connect the system. The cable has a lifetime manufacturer's warranty.

Choose from three wattages: 
100W for new-builds or secondary heating in older homes.
150W for primary heating in bathrooms, kitchens, and living areas.
200W for faster warm-up times and high heat loss areas.

Heavy Duty Manhole Lifting Pin

Here at SecureFix Direct we currently have in stock a huge selection of lifting equipment and other tools including Web Slings, Shackles and Lifting Clutches, the latest addition to our impressive range are these Manhole Lifting Pins.

product.name: 54mm 45 Degree Plastic Hose Connector Blue Barbed Hose Connector for Garden Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes
product.description: This 45 Degree Plastic Hose Connector is a practical solution for creating smooth, angled connections between hoses. Manufactured from tough, lightweight ABS plastic, it offers excellent durability and resistance to weathering, corrosion, and everyday wear. The 45-degree design helps reduce hose stress while maintaining steady water flow, making it particularly useful in spaces where a gentle directional change is required. With its barbed ends, the connector ensures a firm grip on the hose, preventing leaks and slippage even when used under pressure. Perfect for use with garden hoses, pond hoses, aquarium setups, or general water systems, this connector supports efficient water management in both domestic and professional settings. Quick and easy to install, simply push the hose ends over the barbs to achieve a secure, watertight seal. Whether used in irrigation, pond filtration, or household water projects, it helps maintain neat and organised hose routing while protecting hoses from kinking. Combining reliability, strength, and ease of use, this connector is an essential accessory for gardeners, pond enthusiasts, and DIY users who need a cost-effective and long-lasting way to manage hose connections effectively.

product.name: Vinyl Bath Mat Runner Non Slip UV Resistant Cut-to-Size Underfloor Heating Blue/White 60 x 90 cm
product.description:
Vinyl Bathroom Runner - Non-slip and Hard-wearing
The attractive bath mat made of a robust vinyl-polyester mix convinces with a resistant structure and its durability. Thanks to the slip-resistant PVC backing and the high dead weight, this bathroom floor covering always stays in the desired position and does not slip. Furthermore, the insensitive bathroom carpet has an impact sound-absorbing and dirt-repellent effect and is thus optimally suited for your bathroom furnishings. Thanks to its cold-insulating properties, this bath mat also protects you from an unpleasantly cold floor after a bath or shower. Of course, the bath mat can also be used in rooms with underfloor heating.
Individual design - many designs available
Discover our large selection of different sizes, colours and designs in the bathroom rugs and thus design your bathroom individually. Whether it's just a small shower mat or a complete bath set - you'll find the right thing for your personal oasis of well-being in the bathroom at home. For a modern look, you can choose from a variety of strong and subtle colours. You can easily cut the bath mats to your own personal dimensions, or to cut out corners, for example, using a cutting tool.
Easy-care and quick to clean
The fibres of the shower mat do not absorb dirt. Contaminants remain on the surface and can thus be easily removed with a hoover or a little water. Mould stains or mould growth do not occur, as moisture does not soak into the fibres of the bathroom rugs and the bathroom floor coverings dry again quickly as a result.

product.name: MOTUL Radiator Cleaner Flush 2x300ml Cleans & Removes Deposits Cooling System
product.description:
MOTUL RADIATOR CLEAN
Effectively cleans deposits and clogging in the engine cooling circuit
Extends the life span of all components
Increases the operational liability of the cooling system
Improves heating and cooling performances
Description

MOTUL RADIATOR CLEAN is designed to be used in all types of Gasoline and Diesel engines, naturally aspirated or turbocharged, with or without catalytic converter, using all kind of fuel. MOTUL RADIATOR CLEAN effectively cleans deposits and clogging which appear in the engine cooling circuit. The removed deposits and micro-particles are then evacuated at the time of the coolant drain. MOTUL RADIATOR CLEAN provides a perfect lubrication during cleaning process of the coolant circuit. Recommended for use in all liquid cooled, closed cooling systems as in passenger cars, commercial vehicles… and industrial heat exchangers. Improves heating and cooling performance. Increases the operational liability of the cooling system and extends the life span of all components.

product.name: Liqui Moly 5189  Pro-Line Radiator Cleaner Coolant System Flush  1L
product.description:
Liqui Moly Pro-Line Radiator Cleaner
Deposits in the cooling/heating system create blockages for heat exchange and they also block thermostat valves and control mechanisms. When engine temperatures are too high, the engine runs uneconomically and suffers excessive wear at considerable risk of damage. This concentrate safely removes deposits containing oil and lime and ensures that the engine runs reliably and at the optimum temperature. Does not contain aggressive acids or alkalis.




For all coolant and heating systems. Compatible with all commonly used cooling water refiners and antifreezes. 1 l is sufficient for up to 50 l of coolant.

Key Features:

removes oil and grease-based contaminants
chemical conversion of lime
does not contain acids or alkali
compatible with antifreeze
good material compatibility
neutral behavior on rubber and plastics
neutralizes acids
disperses sludge


Applic­a­tion
Add contents to the coolant and start up the heater. Depending on the level of contamination, run the engine at operating temperature for 10 – 30 minutes. Drain the cleaner, thoroughly flush out the cooling system with water and fill according to the manufacturer's specifications. Contents will treat up to 50 liters of coolant.




Other inform­a­tion

Store free of frost.




Contains biocides as protective agents. Contains a mixture of 5-chloro-2-methyl-2H-isothiazol-3-one [EC no. 247-500-7] and 2-methyl-2H-isothiazol-3-one [EC no. 220-239-6] (3:1).

product.name: camlock cam & groove layflat hose fittings type A, female bsp thread pump connector
product.description:
Camlock Type A fittings are a type of quick-connect coupling commonly used in fluid transfer systems. These fittings consist of a male adaptor with a male thread on one end and a camlock (grooved) connection on the other. The male thread allows the fitting to be connected to a female-threaded pipe or hose, while the camlock connection is designed to quickly and securely connect to a female camlock coupler (Types B, C, D, or DC).

Material: Camlock Type A fittings are typically made from a variety of materials, including aluminum, stainless steel, brass, and polypropylene, depending on the application requirements.

Sizes: These fittings are available in a range of sizes, typically from ½ inch to 6 inches, to accommodate different hose and pipe diameters.

Design Features:

Male Adaptor: One end has a male threaded adaptor, which can be screwed into a female-threaded component.
Grooved End: The opposite end features the camlock design, which includes a groove that allows the female camlock coupler to latch securely onto it using cam arms.
Uses of Camlock Type A Fittings:
Camlock Type A fittings are used in a wide range of industries due to their versatility and ease of use. Here are some common applications:

Fluid Transfer Systems:

Used in the transfer of liquids, including water, chemicals, petroleum products, and fuels, from one container or pipe to another.
Agriculture:

Employed in irrigation systems, pesticide spraying, and transferring liquid fertilizers.
Chemical Processing:

Utilized in industries where chemicals are transferred between tanks, pipes, and machinery.
Food and Beverage Industry:

Used in sanitary applications for transferring liquids like juices, milk, and other food-grade substances, especially when made from stainless steel or other sanitary materials.
Petroleum Industry:

Essential in the transfer of fuels and other petroleum-based liquids, where a secure, leak-proof connection is crucial.

product.name: Fullex Kinetica+ K4 3-Star Keyed-Alike Euro Cylinders - Chrome, 45/50 (95mm), 2 Extra (7 total)
product.description: Pair of high security TS007 3-Star Kinetica+ keyed-alike euro cylinders combining advanced anti-snap, anti-bump, anti-drill, anti-pick and anti-plug pull protection with its revolutionary anti-tilt cam and sprung anti-grip drive bar. Recognised as leading the field in euro cylinder security, Kinetica+ holds Secured by Design accreditation and provides outstanding resistance against lock-snapping attacks. Kinetica+ uses a variety of specially engineered, hardened steel anti-bump, drill, and pick pins, whilst its core is reinforced by a super-strong strengthening bar that ensures a robust and durable lock. Lock snapping is a huge concern, so Kinetica+ combines several defensive mechanisms. A sacrificial cut ensures the cylinder snaps in front of the vulnerable cam area, and at the moment of failure, an anti-grip drive bar springs forward, and is stopped by dual attack rods that fire sideways. The rotating cam moves independantly, and stops when its outer defence ring hits the barrels. Dual attack rods limit the space attacker can work in, making it impossible to push the drive bar backwards to release the cam. The attacker will also fail to grab the drive bar, due to the bars tapered anti-grip ends. Leaving no way of manipulating or removing the cam. An innovative anti-tilt mechanism prevents the cam section from lowering when the cylinder is snapped, reducing further the space an attacker has to manipulate the mechanism. Following a snap attack, Kinetica+ leaves the lock protected on the outside, and operational on the inside. IMPORTANT SIZE INFORMATION: Kinetica+ cylinder size is represented with the external measurement first, and internal measurement second. Size should be measured from face of cylinder to centre of screw hole. If your cylinder measures 35mm from outside face to centre of screw hole, and 45mm from centre of screw hole to inside face (80mm overall), then you should order a 35/45 (80mm) cylinder.
